sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:17

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:17:1
items.html: Before it draws the measure of one Sefira far from the Ohr. As long as there is Zivug in the highest Sefira, the He’arat Zivug comes from there to the empty Sefira below it. At that time this He’arah reaches only the Behinat Achor in the Kli and not at all the Panim. Thus, the Panim of the Kli are turned downward.However, after the Ohr departs from the highest Sefira as well, the He’arat Zivug reaches only from the Elyon to the Tachton, meaning from the cause to the consequence but not from above its cause. This is so even though there is still Zivug in the Sefira above the Upper One.Thus, the He’arat Reshimo returns and returns its Panim upward. This is his precision, “Before it draws the measure of one Sefira far from the Ohr,” and examine carefully.
